brief.zh: 完成独立函数 row_total(values)。返回一排零件数的合计，空排返回 0。通过后可以保存供其他任务导入。
brief.en: Complete the standalone row_total(values). Return the sum for one row of parts, or 0 for an empty row. After it passes, save it to import in other tasks.

concept.zh: 独立测试处理单排的内层逻辑
concept.en: Test the inner work for a single row on its own

hints.zh: 合计初始是 0，把每个数字加一次。
hints.en: Start at 0 and add each value once.

hints.zh: return 放在循环后面，这样空排也能返回 0。
hints.en: Put return after the loop so even an empty row returns 0.

label.en: Loop through and add the row

        total = total + value
